Prepare data for the district viewer's Finance tab

txs_viewer_prepare_finance.Rd

Builds the baked artifact behind the viewer's optional Finance tab: a district-level summary of PEIMS budget/actual data across the requested school years, small enough to browse instantly once prepared. This is a separate, optional step from txs_viewer_prepare() – the Map and Compare tabs work without it – because it is meaningfully slower: a district actual file is tens of millions of dollars across millions of rows and several megabytes to download and parse, and this fetches several such files. With the default scope (five school years, both budget and actual, both districts and charters), expect roughly 10-20 minutes on first run; subsequent runs reuse each file's on-disk cache.

Usage

txs_viewer_prepare_finance(
  years = NULL,
  basis = c("actual", "budget"),
  dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of ending school years; NULL (the default) resolves to the five most recent years txs_list_years() reports for PEIMS.

basis

Character vector: "actual", "budget", or both (default both) – unlike txs_get_peims_finance()'s single-choice basis, every requested value is fetched.

dir

Output directory; default file.path(txs_cache_dir(), "viewer"), where txs_viewer() looks.

refresh

Ignore on-disk caches and refetch.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, a list with dir, path, n_rows, years, and the combinations that succeeded/failed.

Details

Each requested (year, basis, type) combination is fetched with txs_get_peims_finance() and campus-level detail (fin_unit, campus_name) is summed away – the Finance tab draws district-wide flows, not per-campus ones – keeping every other column (including the full fund/function/object/program code detail txs_peims_flow() needs for any axis combination). A combination TEA has not published yet (e.g. the newest actual year) is skipped with a warning rather than aborting the whole prepare.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_viewer_prepare_finance()
txs_viewer()
} # }
